history.method: v1 (single Haiku investigator per repo + excerpt-only Haiku judge)
history.note: dev results seen; v2 changes justified by coverage 15-57% and judge confirm rate 74-100% (no answer key)

history.contamination: the orchestrator saw the held-out cases' route names in the collector's summary table. Mitigation: prompts keep the generic IDOR definition only (no object-type lists); an object checklist was drafted and removed because it echoed held-out routes. Final headline numbers should come from fresh cases collected by an agent that reports only slugs, never routes.

history.method: v2 FROZEN: route partitions (<=20/batch, every route gets a verdict) + blind excerpt judge + refuter with code access; convention-routing fallback when <15 declared routes
history.note: held-out cases (easyappointments, xxl-job, khoj, flowise) and fresh cases run with exactly these files

history.method: v2.1 FROZEN: v2 + partition dedup keyed by (method, path, file) and findings merged per batch
history.reason: pipeline bug, not prompt tuning: identical relative route strings from different routers were deduplicated, dropping 13 routes in khoj and 3 in filebrowser before any LLM saw them (measured: unique lines vs lines in batches)
history.consequence: khoj moved from held_out to dev (its result exposed the bug). Fresh cases are the clean test for v2.1.

history.method: v2.2 FROZEN: v2.1 + findings merged per (batch, route, handler file); pack index/claims carry the handler file
history.reason: pipeline bug, not prompt tuning: with router-relative route strings ('GET /') findings for different handlers in one batch were merged into one, measured as coverage 207/306 findings kept on a TypeScript repo (no answer key used). After the fix 279/306.
history.consequence: flowise moved from held_out to dev (its coverage stats drove the change). t01-t16 judged with v2.1 packs (v2.1 merge lost 4-19 findings there); flowise and the fresh cases use v2.2. Held-out headline: easyappointments, xxl-job; fresh cases are the clean test.
history.note: haiku_flow.prepare also accepts a case file (fresh_cases.json); no effect on the analysis

history.method: v2.3 FROZEN: v2.2 + mandatory rag.sh per referenced object type (logged, verified by checkrag; batches under 80% compliance are rerun) + ownership_model evidence role + budget 50 tool calls
history.reason: measured without the answer key: only 20 of 174 v2.2 investigators called rag.sh (45 calls total), so the RAG component was untested. Requested by the user.
history.also_seen: the snipe-it fresh miss (judge 'unclear' for lack of ownership context) was diagnosed after scoring; the ownership_model role addresses that category. Snipe-it is therefore NOT a clean test for v2.3; its rerun (t25, reports/bench_v23) is an A/B diagnostic only.
history.clean_test: fresh cases not yet run under any version: spree, nl-portal, oqtane
